children: Crude oil climbed Monday while Bitcoin, gold and other metals fell as markets positioned for Wednesday’s Federal Reserve rate decision. Brent rose 2.75% to $107.48 and West Texas Intermediate gained 2.51% to $102.56, while Bitcoin traded near $76,718 and Ethereum slipped to $2,478.43, according to BeInCrypto, amid hotter-than-expected US inflation data and higher Fed hike odds.
Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline outage, fresh Houthi strikes and tensions around Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb added to supply concerns.

title: Crude Oil Rises As Bitcoin And Gold Fall Ahead Of Fed Decision
